recommendations.data_design: Include multi-event antecedent + amendment + adoption/owner evidence. Add contrast candidates with correct final text but wrong or incomplete citations. Include direct standalone evidence that needs only one event, so overcitation is not the learned default.
recommendations.review_gate: Evaluate candidate completeness and citation entailment separately using one frozen rule; audit identical candidates for arm-invariant treatment.

recommendations.data_design: Mix repair with independent cancellation and already-withdrawn records; explicitly cover do-not-touch withdrawn state and runtime one-operation-per-ID.
recommendations.review_gate: Actual IntentStore replay plus semantic checks on active, uncertain and withdrawn units. Rejected patches retain old state and remain in denominators.
